name: Vess Manor
description: Vess Manor is Liliana's family home, a once-grand estate overshadowing the town of Vess, now ruined in a corrupted swamp on Dominaria.

summary.text: Vess Manor is Liliana's family home, a once-grand estate overshadowing the town of Vess, now ruined in a corrupted swamp on Dominaria.

bio.text: Liliana grew up in the manor and met the Raven Man there while trying to cure her sick brother.

citations.text: "Caligo Morass", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She gave her brother Josu a false remedy that turned him into a lich, and he killed Lady Ana before Liliana fled as her spark ignited.

citations.text: "Caligo Morass", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

bio.text: A separate story shows Liliana trying to tame the Chain Veil in her manor's tower before werewolves overran her throne room and killed Dierk.

citations.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.
"Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

bio.text: Years later, Gideon gathered the Benalish forces at the manor, and Liliana drew Josu there and destroyed him with the Chain Veil, which also aged the preserved manor into ruin.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

bio.text: Liliana returned to the ruined estate, where she met the Raven Man in a dream and fought Elas il-Kor's Phyrexians, then buried the ring deeper beneath Dominaria.

citations.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

bio.text: Centuries later, freed from her contracts, she began rebuilding the manor's husk, and the manor is mentioned as one to be reconstructed.

timeline.summary: Liliana lures the lich back to Vess Manor and breaks the lich spell with the Chain Veil; Josu tells her she is the real curse.
timeline.quote: She broke the lich spell with the help of the Chain Veil .

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched again". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana, Dierk and Gared try to tame the Chain Veil by channeling lightning and geists through a witchbane orb.
timeline.quote: Liliana's teeth clenched involuntarily as the surge came.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The geist circuit fails to draw off any backlash, and the Veil's pain overwhelms Liliana.
timeline.quote: The geist circuit had not drawn off any of the backlash.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The equipment is ruined and Liliana cries out; she dismisses Dierk, who takes the orb to Olivia.
timeline.quote: You may see yourself out. Deliver the orb back to its owner.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana wants Jace to owe her, then hears a scream and finds werewolves overrunning her throne room.
timeline.quote: Werewolves. Liliana's entire throne room was overrun.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The warped werewolves kill Dierk, raking his chest open.
timeline.quote: Dierk lay on the floor, his chest raked open.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls how her attempt to heal Josu raised him as an undead who killed Lady Ana before she fled as her spark ignited (flashback).
timeline.quote: She had meant only to heal him, and instead turned him into a mindless undead monster that killed Lady Ana, killed her servants

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Vess Manor still standing.
timeline.quote: The house was still here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds charred necromantic symbols and blood, convincing her it was no coincidence.
timeline.quote: Whatever had happened here, it was no coincidence.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon gathers the Benalish forces at Vess Manor.
timeline.quote: When the next day dawned, they were at the high ground around Vess Manor with a small force of Benalish soldiers, knights, and aven scouts.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon asks Corin to make a dread shade mistake him for a skin witch.
timeline.quote: Corin, with Liliana's help, could you create an illusion? Make a dread shade think I'm a skin witch?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Corin casts the illusion over Gideon.
timeline.quote: As Corin cast the spell, Gideon felt the illusion settle over him like a wet blanket.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls to Josu through the wind, drawing him to the manor.
timeline.quote: Josu Vess, I am here.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Josu appears in spiked dark armor as Belzenlok's lich general.
timeline.quote: The magic that had transformed him from a mindless undead remnant into Belzenlok's lich general had covered his shape with dark metal armor.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana draws on the Chain Veil, killing undead across the Morass.
timeline.quote: The Onakke bound into the Chain Veil whispered in her mind as she drew on raw power.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Veil destroys Josu, leaving his decomposing corpse.
timeline.quote: crumpled before her on the paving stones was the decomposing corpse of her brother.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Chain Veil blasts away the preserved manor, aging it into ruin.
timeline.quote: the Chain Veil had blasted it all away, aging the house until it was a crumbled ruin.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: With his last words Josu blames Liliana for the curse of the House of Vess.
timeline.quote: You killed me. You killed them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Josu dissolves into dust.
timeline.quote: And he was gone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes her family died trying to end the evil she created.
timeline.quote: And worse still, her family, all dead trying to end the evil she had created.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana vows to destroy Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: I will pry open his Stronghold, slaughter his grimnants, and destroy his legacy.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 2" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana arrives at the ruined Vess estate and falls asleep under the oak in the graveyard, where the Raven Man appears in a dream.
timeline.quote: the Raven Man stood before her

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana names him Lim-Dûl and learns he wants her as Dominaria's weapon against a threat; he warns her to save herself.
timeline.quote: I called you to be Dominaria's weapon.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Exploring the swamp, Liliana senses an alien taint and is confronted by Elas il-Kor, a kor Phyrexian, and a team of patchwork soldiers.
timeline.quote: "You have entered our gathering grounds, and you are thus forfeit."

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Elas il-Kor says her team is excavating to find an object anchoring the spirit; Liliana decides not to flee and to stop them.
timeline.quote: "The spirit we pursue is anchored to an object somewhere in this place,"

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the swamp's dead against the Phyrexians and retreats to her family graveyard.
timeline.quote: Liliana had the dead of an entire biome.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts the Phyrexians with rotting light; Elas throws a javelin that wounds Liliana's shoulder.
timeline.quote: it struck Liliana in the shoulder.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Reaching into the ring's power, Liliana sees the history of the Raven Man's necromancer lineage and that she was meant to be the next vessel, but refuses.
timeline.quote: She had been intended as one more link in a line stretching back to that first, now-nameless mage

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises the dead Phyrexians against Elas il-Kor, who flees.
timeline.quote: Then, choosing survival over her soldiers' fate, she fled.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana buries the ring deeper beneath Dominaria to deny the Phyrexians and planeswalks back to Arcavios.
timeline.quote: she pushed the artifact downward, commanding the ancient dead to hide the object away

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The Raven Man watches her leave, content that he manipulated her into protecting him.
timeline.quote: She had protected him, in the end.

citation.text: "Homecoming" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Liliana grows up in her manor and meets the Raven Man while trying to cure her sick brother.
timeline.quote: where she first met the Raven Man while trying to find a cure for her sick brother

citation.text: "Caligo Morass", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana gives her brother Josu a false remedy that turns him into a lich.
timeline.quote: This was where Liliana gave her brother Josu a false remedy, which instead turned him into a lich

citation.text: "Caligo Morass", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Centuries later, freed from her contracts, Liliana returns and begins rebuilding the manor's husk.
timeline.quote: She began rebuilding the manor's husk

citation.text: "Caligo Morass", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
